evidence: state PIDs were dead immediately after successful oneshot completion
rootCause.conclusion: Long-lived ctrld/nfqws were launched as children of a oneshot action unit and were killed when that unit became inactive.

prevention.method: launch ctrld and nfqws as independent transient systemd services via systemd-run --collect --service-type=exec; obtain MainPID via systemctl show
prevention.rationale: Keep long-lived daemons in systemd-owned independent cgroups instead of escaping/relaxing KillMode.
